lines.text: It is in the first place judged in that its claim, to be limited
to itself and fulfilled in itself, works out its inexorable conse-
quences. Inasmuch as it closes its mind to the challenge of the
word of Jesus and fails to grasp that its own existence is being
questioned, it remains abandoned to itself and lost; because
it shuts out the divine light it remains in darkness, however
little it realizes this and however much it supposes it has the
light. But it is also judged in that its power is broken. The
power of the world is not destroyed by the fact that there are
courageous men of steadfast character who are ready to
sacrifice themselves for Jesus. It is not we who execute the
judgment on the world by resisting it.
"With force of arms we nothing can,
Full soon were we down-ridden."
And moreover there are courageous men of steadfast
character in the world itself.
Rather the power of the world is broken as a result of the
fact that the word of Jesus is proclaimed in it and again and
again endows weak men with the power to resist the world.
Probably the most subtle seduction of the world lies in the
fact that, in so far as it can respect human heroism, it also
respects brave Christians. And of course the Christian by his
courage must secure respect for the cause he represents. But
for the cause itself! It is not a question of his own human
qualities being respected. And the Christian knows that even
the most ardent readiness for sacrifice does not in itself prove
the rightness of his cause. Were it not so, then it would
depend on the Christian himself to achieve victory over the
prince of this world. But the Scripture says: "Of judgment
because the ruler of this world is judged." He is already
judged and his power already broken.
The very existence of the Christian Church, with its
proclamation of the gospel of Christ in the world, proves that
the power of the world is broken. The Church is a symbol of
eternity in the midst of the self-sufficient world. The word
of the gospel resounds in the world and does not allow it to
